title: Work phone in practice
intro: Keep your work phone managed and safe. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: İşCihaz: Finish enrolment
decisions.prompt: Technical support installed this app themselves. What do you do?

artifact.title: İşCihaz: Finish enrolment
body: Technical support has prepared your device. Finish enrolment to get work mail.

decisions.explain: Enrolling through your organisation's own app is the safest way.

decisions.title: Call from Technical support

artifact.name: Technical support
body: Hello, this is technical support. To lock your phone we sent you an SMS code. Please read it out.

options.label: I will call the official number myself

decisions.explain: Checking on the official number exposes a fake call at once.

decisions.title: Message from IT-Support
decisions.prompt: Check the sender and the link address. What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: IT-Support
body: Dear colleague, your MDM profile expires today. Install the new profile so your phone is not blocked: iscihaz-profil.example.net/new

decisions.explain: Your report lets technical support warn everyone else too.

decisions.title: YolXəritə asks for access
decisions.prompt: Is this request safe on a work phone, or a threat?

artifact.title: YolXəritə asks for access
body: Location: only while the app is open

decisions.explain: A map needs location, and only while it is open. The permission fits the job.

decisions.title: Super Oyunlar asks for access
decisions.prompt: Is this request safe on a work phone, or a threat?
decisions.explain: A game needs neither SMS nor contacts. SMS access lets it read your sign-in codes.
